summary: Well-engineered with proper bash conventions (set -euo pipefail, quoted vars, early validation), least-privilege workflow permissions, and meaningful error handling. Issues: (1) workflow doesn't explicitly install jq, yet validator.sh requires it (assumes ubuntu-latest pre-install); (2) missing .actrc file referenced in run-act-tests.sh; (3) test harness hardcoded to 3 cases, not scalable; (4) complex jq expressions (lines 126–134) lack inline explanation of ascii unit separator join logic.
